beats: When a kid asks why the moon has phases, a text answer never really lands.
Now he just asks out loud, in Ukrainian or Norwegian, and a bot takes down the question.
The answer comes back as its own little movie - camera flights, 3D models, tiny math scenes, built with Remotion.
The very first one, 'chicken or egg', played start to finish, made just for him.
Behind it, six separate renders finish together - so no answer makes him wait.
